name: request_reset_generates_token_for_registered_email
description: Calls PasswordResetService.request_reset(email) and asserts a non-empty token string is returned.

name: reset_password_with_valid_token_updates_and_invalidates
description: Calls request_reset to get a token, then reset_password(token, new_password) and asserts it returns True; calling reset_password again with the same token asserts it returns False.

name: reset_password_with_unknown_token_is_rejected
description: Calls reset_password('not-a-real-token', 'x') and asserts it returns False.

name: reset_password_locks_account_after_three_failed_attempts
description: Calls PasswordResetService.lock_account_after_attempts(email, 3) and asserts the account is locked.
